title: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
summary: Make an adjective agree with its genitive noun: ison talon ovi (“the big house's door”).
targetSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
objectives: Make an adjective agree with its genitive noun: ison talon ovi (“the big house's door”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: An adjective before a noun agrees with that noun in case and number. A later head noun, such as ovi, belongs to a different part of the phrase.
Adjective models: iso → ison, pieni → pienen, uusi → uuden, vanha → vanhan.
The noun forms are talon and auton. They are provided in the questions so that the adjective agreement stays central.
keyPoints: Change the adjective as well as the noun.

examples.english: The door of the big house.
steps: The adjective agrees with talon: use ison talon. Both modifier words are singular genitives.
The surrounding words keep the forms shown; the genitive target expresses this lesson's relationship.
